tiers.name: Unaligned Ragged M_e (M_0=13, M_1=47...) -> Non-TMA Fallback / Serial cuBLAS Loop
tiers.note: Odd M_e offsets violate 16-byte/128-byte TMA row-alignment and 64-row WGMMA tile boundaries -> falls back to 185 TFLOPS (18.7% util)!

tiers.name: CUTLASS Ptr-Array Grouped GEMM With Host CPU cuTensorMap Rebuild Per Layer
tiers.note: Re-encoding 32 CUtensorMap descriptors on CPU and copying to HBM every layer stalls the stream 420 us/layer (25.6 ms across 61 layers)!

tiers.name: Fixed M=128 Contiguous Token-Bucket Padding + Single Static TMA Descriptor
tiers.note: Pads each expert's start offset to a multiple of 128 rows in 1 contiguous tensor (0 us TMA rebuild!), but M=128 wastes 24.5% FLOPs on small batches.

tiers.name: DeepGEMM Adaptive M=64/128 Aligned Permute + Single Static TMA + Device Scheduler
tiers.note: Aligns expert row offsets to M_BLOCK=64 (decode/medium) or 128 (prefill) inside FusedPermute, using 1 static 2D TMA descriptor -> 1,140 TFLOPS (6.16x)!
